elements.evidence: "automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless terminated by either Party hereto upon 30 days written notice to the other"
"HDI shall notify the Company at least 60 days before each renewal"

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "any price increase for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%"

elements.element: Automatic renewal with non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days

elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%"

reasons: Preferred level is fully assembled: 12-month auto-renewal retained, opt-out notice reduced to 30 days, an express 60-day pre-renewal reminder from HDI (the hosting provider/vendor) inserted, and a renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
Edits are surgical: a single number replacement (90 -> 30) plus one concise new subsection 4.1.1 for the otherwise absent reminder and pricing mechanics; no boilerplate or whole-clause rewrite.

Caveat worth noting in the rationale rather than as a defect: because clause 4.1 conflates non-renewal with either-party termination, shortening the window to 30 days also lets HDI exit on 30 days' notice; if that matters commercially, split the non-renewal notice from the termination-for-convenience notice.
No undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics introduced; HDI and Company are defined parties and the Termination Date mechanic is untouched.
